network_status.summary_it: La sinossi ARPAV conferma le precipitazioni abbondanti del 10-11 novembre sulle Prealpi e sulle Dolomiti, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata evento-specifici sul torrente Terche a Mel. Il contesto meteorologico non viene convertito in idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAV review confirms abundant 10-11 November precipitation over the Prealps and Dolomites but publishes no event-specific stage or discharge for the Terche at Mel. Meteorological context is not converted into hydrometry.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
